In the solar-panel diagram, cloudiness and sun position are shown as inputs taken as given, while production is produced within the model. Which classification is correct?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_d06.model.04
- 'Cloudiness and sun position are endogenous; production is exogenous.':
    correct: false
- 'Cloudiness and sun position are exogenous; production is endogenous.':
    correct: true
- 'All three dimensions are endogenous.':
    correct: false
- 'All three dimensions are exogenous.':
    correct: false
```
